answer_1.quote: We propose DELITERATER: an improved system for Iterative Text Revision, using a delineate-edit-iterate framework, consisting of an intent span detection model, and a text revision generation model, based on the ITERATER framework of .
answer_1.outputs: revised texts with edits applied iteratively based on detected edit intentions and spans

answer_4.quote: We hired a group of proficient linguists to evaluate the quality of the documents being edited across multiple (up to 3) revisions, where each revision was annotated by 3 linguists.
answer_4.guideline: We randomly shuffle the original and revised texts, and ask the evaluators to select which one was better in terms of fluency, coherence, readability, meaning preservation, and overall quality. They could choose one of the two texts, or neither.
